info.name: Set custom status on a referral

params.name: id
params.description: The referral ID. Can also be an email, uid, or username when used with `find_by`.

items.docs:
Assign or clear a custom status on an existing referral by passing `custom_status_id`. First use `GET /api/admin/v1/custom_referral_statuses` to retrieve the IDs of your available statuses, then pass the desired `id` here. Pass `null` to remove the status. **HTTP Request**
`PUT https://api.firstpromoter.com/api/v2/company/referrals/{id}`
